subject: Startups
title: Shein: Fast Fashion's Unicorn
description: One-minute skill: Shein: Fast Fashion's Unicorn.

hook.text: Shein ships 6,000 new clothing items daily. It overtook Zara and H&M online without a single physical store.

buildup.text: Founded in China in 2008, Shein uses real-time data to spot trends and produce micro-batches in days, not months.

discovery.text: When a design sells well, Shein scales production instantly.

twist.text: Critics attack Shein's labor practices and environmental impact. Ultra-fast fashion has a dark sustainability cost.

punchline.text: Speed and data beat heritage and brand legacy.

quiz.question: What gives Shein an edge over traditional fashion brands?
